profile.headline: Core Infra @ Harvey
profile.summary: Former startup founder & CTO with a strong track record of designing performant & reliable systems under real-world constraints. Most interested in working on large-scale backend systems, orchestration, and performance-critical platform design. Currently part of an incredible Core Infrastructure team tackling that class of problems at Harvey.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Core Infra team, working on model infrastructure.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Led Hive's model serving team to ship two critical systems: the system to load models just-in-time in the inference path, and a fully rearchitected model autoscaler. 

Drove the technical direction across the team - defined the roadmap, led design reviews, and established stronger software design patterns.

Cut paging by 4x by introducing more sophisticated model server health checks, improving load balancing strategies, and retargeting alerts to focus on externally visible symptoms rather than noisy internal signals.

positions.title: Advisor
positions.description: Provide leadership with advice at the intersection of engineering, product, and strategy.

positions.title: Co-Founder, CTO
positions.description:
Tradewing is an enterprise SaaS product for trade and professional associations - tradewing.com

Scaled Tradewing from zero to substantial ARR and enterprise customer count alongside an incredible team and backing from top-tier investors.

Hired and led a team of skilled engineers, designers and product managers to ship a complex enterprise system that is mission-critical to our customers.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · GraphQL · Apollo GraphQL · Node.js · Web Application Development · Technical Leadership · Engineering Management · React.js · MongoDB · Datadog · Redis · Heroku · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PagerDuty · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer in Core Systems - Kernel Applications Team, L4

• Shipped performance and security enhancements to Facebook’s network block device infrastructure, a data-storage layer backing Facebook’s core database servers.
• Led the effort to utilize Linux’s kernel TLS, allowing in-flight encryption of network block device traffic while eliminating unnecessary copies between user-space and kernel-space.
• Found and patched bugs in Linux’s kernel TLS implementation, merged my work into upstream Linux - tinyurl.com/doron-linux
• 20% project: Utilized new x86 SIMD instruction to improve cache hit rate of the concurrent hash map in Facebook’s C++ library.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Improved reliability and maintainability of API billing pipeline by writing a reusable stream consumption component that allowed for the deletion of redundant modules across 3 repos.
• Wrote abstraction layer to decouple app logic from cloud-provider specific code, furthering org initiative to reduce vendor lock-in.
• Found and fixed critical bugs impacting customer billing and a memory leak causing production outages.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Designed and built an anomaly-detection & alert system on top of a Kinesis Stream network.

Introduced inheritance to the Hibernate DB schema, enabling deletion of a package from 2 repositories.

Experience with MySQL.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant for CIS-110
positions.description:
Taught undergraduate students object-oriented programming, modularized code, data structure choice, documentation, and testing through a project-based Java class. 

Held a 2 hour lecture and 2 office hours once a week for 25 students.

company.name: School of Engineering, University of Pennsylvania

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Designed and built a distributed, multi-threaded web-crawler written in Java. The crawler could simultaneously crawl over 100 domains (highest tested) while respecting a politeness delay between successive requests to the same domain. The crawler could also interleave tasks from multiple jobs, each with unique behavior specified in a JSON file.

positions.title: Batch Member
positions.description:
Participated in Hacker School - a self-directed, collaborative, project-based retreat for people who want to dedicate 3 months to becoming a better programmer.

My projects included: a JavaScript music sequencer web app that supports simultaneous editing by multiple clients, a digital synthesizer controlled by MacBook trackpad gestures built using ChucK, and a non-blocking Tic-Tac-Toe server that defeats clients using Min-Max.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Developed code in Python and Java to create counterbalanced stimulus sets as well as perform statistical analyses of brain image data.

Played active role in experimental design of fMRI studies examining the influence of high-level concepts on neural activation patterns in the early visual areas - a region of the brain previously thought to only encode low-level visual patterns. 

Co-author of manuscript submitted to the Journal of Neuroscience, "Similarity of meaning modulates neural similarity within extrastriate cortex," describing the effects of meaning on neural representation in the visual areas, as well as the first direct, fMRI evidence of this phenomenon. 

First author of research poster, Center for Undergraduate Research and Fellowships conference
Independently coordinated and administered fMRI scans to cohort of human subjects.

Received Undergraduate Research Mentorship Award, awarded to ~10% of over 500 applicants

company.name: Center for Cognitive Neuroscience, University of Pennsylvania

educations.fieldOfStudy: Double Major in Computer Science and Cognitive Science (Computational Neuroscience)

honors.title: Penn Undergraduate Research Mentorship Award
honors.issuer: Issued by Center For Undergraduate Research and Fellowships · May 2013
